findings.what: DIV stop-rule gap. W2 v4 (1) runs exp80a only if disp(exp78b) >= disp(exp78a). S3 says 'exp78b + -> exp80a in W2a' and S2 covers only 'exp78a + and exp78b not +'. So the world where both are '+' with exp78a strictly above exp78b (for example 0.958 vs 0.957) has two conflicting readings: exp80a (S3) or exp81 (W2a (1)). The follow-on for W3/W4 DIV steps is also undefined there.
